ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows lungs with several letter labels. A large letter E is on the right side of the image, and its pointer line leads to a curved inward indentation along the medial border of the lung shown on that side. Reasoning: The question asks what anatomical structure the letter E represents. The left lung has a characteristic inward indentation where the heart sits, called the cardiac notch. Since E points to that indentation, E represents the cardiac notch.
